title: Normalize embedding vectors
description: NumPy normalizes vector rows, selects rows, averages them, and computes simple vector operations.

steps.description: vectors holds three two-number rows. norm computes one length per row, and division normalizes every row to length 1.
The first normalized vector prints as [0.6 0.8].
group names rows 0 and 1. Indexing selects those rows, then mean averages down their columns.

steps.question: What operation does @ perform between the first two normalized rows?

steps.description: The rounded dot product prints as 0.8.
argmax returns index 1, the position of 0.9 in the list.
